messages:
Samir Patel: Hey team — small change for Wed's Platform Standards sync (AR Board). I'm swapping facilitation with @Jules. Can folks add must-review RFCs or rollouts here by EOD Tuesday? :calendar:
Olivia Chen: Quick Q — can we move RFC review earlier (first 20m)? I've got a deploy at 11:30.
Diego Ramos: heads up — out Tue afternoon. If you need me to present the cache eviction RFC, ping me today.
Jules (platform-eng): happy to facil. I'll reorder: 1) 20m RFC reviews (priority: cache eviction, preemptible routing), 2) 15m standards follow-ups, 3) 10m triage/anything else. Agree?
Maya Ito: SGTM. Suggest we add a pre-read link and mark owners. I'll make the calendar event description.
Olivia Chen: added RFC links + owners. Also flagging that the staged rollout guidelines doc needs a quick sign-off.
Samir Patel: thanks. Two logistics: 1) if someone wants to swap slots DM me; 2) if presenting, please add 3 slide max to the drive by Tue 10:00.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Platform Standards — AR Board" Wed Mar 25 11:00-11:45 (Jules facilitating). Pre-reads: https://drive.company/redwood/platform/ar-board/pre-reads Attendees: @Samir, @Olivia, @Diego, @Maya, @Jules
Diego Ramos: noted — will drop slides by 9am Wed. ping me for dry-run.
Jules (platform-eng): I'll send agenda + timing today. Proposed agenda template:
```
Agenda
- 00:00-20:00 RFC reviews (name - owner - decision)
- 20:00-35:00 Standards follow-ups
- 35:00-45:00 Triage / action items
```
Any objections?
Olivia Chen: none. Can we reserve the first 5m for NSM updates?
Maya Ito: added NSM 5m at top. Also can someone volunteer to take notes?
Samir Patel: @Olivia can you take notes this round? I'll rotate note-taker next time.
Olivia Chen: can do.
calendar-bot: Reminder set: 24h and 1h before meeting.
